name: Wes Zuber
office: Wrightwood Community Services District, Member, Board of Directors

items.text: Wes Zuber says he is the founder and owner of UIA, an infrastructure services company. He served as the first president of the Wrightwood Community Services District board and helped set up the district's billing and accounting processes when it was established. He says he would prioritize operational efficiency, reliable services, and careful use of public funds.
